name: Rama
source:
Rama is a strange guy who seemed to only care to have fun. His carefree and fun-loving personality naturally attracted the children and he spent most of his time playing dangerous games with Dani, Ares, and Puspa; much to Mitra's chagrin and dismay. Is that all about Rama? Nope, Tamara sure had seen glimpses of his other mysterious side.

"Sure... After we play one more time."

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36078]lemmasoft[/url]]
